steps.en: Open the runner project in Xcode
steps.zh: 在 Xcode 里打开 runner 工程

steps.en: Run the runner scheme on a simulator or device
steps.zh: 在模拟器或真机上运行 runner scheme

steps.en: Build and launch the runner, then start a WebDriver HTTP server on the target
steps.zh: 构建并启动 runner，然后在目标上开一个 WebDriver 服务

steps.en: Send WebDriver and Mobile JSON Wire requests
steps.zh: 发送 WebDriver 与 Mobile JSON Wire 请求

steps.en: Call Apple's API through XCTest to execute the command and return the response
steps.zh: 通过 XCTest 调用 Apple API 执行命令，并回传响应

value.en: iOS accepts standard WebDriver commands on a device or simulator — you build tooling on a real protocol, not private symbols.
value.zh: iOS 在真机或模拟器上接受标准 WebDriver 命令——你在真协议上搭工具，而不是私有符号。

sources: README.md (WebDriver server for iOS, links XCTest.framework, adopted by Appium via XCUITest driver)
README.md Getting Started on This Repository (open WebDriverAgent.xcodeproj, start WebDriverAgentRunner, send requests)
